21.s_dismas: Thou ſhalt take therfore with thee of al meates, that may be eaten, and thou ſhalt lay them vp with thee: and they ſhal be meate for thee and them.
21.odr_com: Thou shalt take therfore with thee of al meates, that may be eaten, and thou shalt lay them vp with thee: and they shal be meate for thee and them.
21.sabates_a: Thou shalt take therefore with thee of all meats, that may be eaten, and thou shalt lay them up with thee: & they shall be meat for thee and them.
21.madueke_b: Thou shalt take therefore with thee of all meats, that may be eaten, and thou shalt lay them up with thee: & they shall be meat for thee and them.

22.s_dismas: Noe therfore did al thinges, which God commanded him.
22.odr_com: Noe therfore did al thinges, which God commanded him.
22.sabates_a: Noe therefore did all things which God commanded him.
22.madueke_b: Noe therefore did all things which God commanded him.

janvier_by_verse.1: And after that men began to be multiplied upon the earth, and had procreation of daughters,
janvier_by_verse.2: the sons of God seeing the daughters of men that they were fair, took to themselves wives out of all which they had chosen.
janvier_by_verse.3: And God said: My spirit shall not remain in man for ever, because he is flesh: and his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
janvier_by_verse.4: And Giants were upon the earth in those days. For after the sons of God did company with the daughters of men, & they brought forth children, these be the mighty of the old world, famous men.
janvier_by_verse.5: And God seeing the malice of men was much on the earth, & that all the cogitation of their heart was bent to evil at all times,
janvier_by_verse.6: it repented him that he had made man on the earth. And touched inwardly with sorrow of heart,
janvier_by_verse.7: I will, saith he, clean take away man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth, from man even to beasts, from that which creepeth even unto the fowls of the air. For it repenteth me that I have made them.
janvier_by_verse.8: But Noe found grace before our Lord.
janvier_by_verse.9: These are the generations of Noe: Noe was a just and perfect man in his generations, he did walk with God.
janvier_by_verse.10: And he begat three sons, Sem, Cham, and Japheth.
janvier_by_verse.11: And the earth was corrupted before God, & was replenished with iniquity.
janvier_by_verse.12: And when God had perceived that the earth was corrupted (for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth)
janvier_by_verse.13: He said to Noe: The end of all flesh is come before me, the earth is replenished with iniquity from the face of them, and I will destroy them with the earth.
janvier_by_verse.14: Make thee an ark of timber plank: cabinets shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with bitume.
janvier_by_verse.15: And thus shalt thou make it. The length of the Ark shall be three hundred cubits: fifty cubits the breadth, and thirty cubits the height of it.
janvier_by_verse.16: Thou shalt make a window in the ark, & in a cubit finish the top of it: & the door of the ark thou shalt set at the side below, middle chambers & third lofts shalt thou make in it.
janvier_by_verse.17: Behold I will bring the waters of a great flood upon the earth, that I may destroy all flesh wherein there is breath of life under heaven. All things that are in the earth shall be consumed.
janvier_by_verse.18: And I will establish my covenant with thee: and thou shalt enter into the ark, thou and thy sons, and thy wife, and the wives of thy sons with thee.
janvier_by_verse.19: And of all living creatures of all flesh, thou shalt bring pairs into the ark, that they may live with thee: of the male sex and the female.
janvier_by_verse.20: Of fowls according to their kind, and beasts in their kind, and of all that creepeth on the earth, according to their kind: pairs of all sorts shall enter in with thee, that they may live.
janvier_by_verse.21: Thou shalt take therefore with thee of all meats, that may be eaten, and thou shalt lay them up with thee: & they shall be meat for thee and them.
janvier_by_verse.22: Noe therefore did all things which God commanded him.
